title: 第八章 柠柠成功，张晚禾的哀伤
slug: 什么网恋的清冷校花竟是双胞胎
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

卧室里，窗帘隔绝了阳光，屋内变得一片昏暗，隐约可见屋内淡白色装修风格，淡白色的床单上，张晚柠青丝如瀑，半遮住修长的鹅颈，清冷精致的脸上隐约可见淡淡的泪痕，修长白嫩的两腿交叉，侧卧在床上。

张晚柠猛地直起身子，半靠在床头柜上，用手捋了捋头发，从枕头下面拿出手机，

无数个深夜，密密麻麻的通话记录。

看着他发的最后一条消息，她停下了手指，叹了口气，这个陪了自己一年多的男孩就这么离开了自己。

她很想把他加回来，告诉他说：“我们可以见面，我现在就可以去找你！”。可真的能吗？

她翻了翻身，平躺在床上，手机响了一下。

母亲发来消息说【下午的钢琴课别忘了，李老师说你状态不太好。】

钢琴，插花，舞蹈，礼仪课等等，从小到大母亲让自己学这么多，不过是想把自己培养成大家闺秀，方便自己以后能嫁一个富二代，一个能给母亲那不大不小的公司带来助力的家庭。

“晚禾，妈对你严格是为你好，女孩要有女孩的样子，以后去了好的人家，才不会被人看轻，这样才能让人家里觉得你是一个相夫教子的女孩。到时候我也能跟你享享清福。”

这也是他母亲从小到大一直不让自己跟异性接触的原因，或许就是为了到时候能在男生那里卖个好价钱吧，可她很想问问自己母亲“难道我在你眼里就是商品吗？”。

但现在的她还没有底气，因为她也需要自己母亲给自己提供的物质条件来维持学业，同样她现在的计划就是学习，毕业后有了自己的工作，才能摆脱这一切。

按她原来的计划，等大学毕业以后，找到一份不错的工作，跟自己妹妹说清楚自己是喜欢舟舟，让妹妹理解自己对舟舟是真的喜欢，她相信妹妹是可以理解自己的。

毕竟她知道妹妹从小就喜欢跟自己抢东西，当时答应妹妹也是妹妹软磨硬泡的结果。她打算毕业后去到舟舟所在的城市工作，租个房子，养只小猫，和舟舟一起工作，一起生活。

想到这里，她把手机翻了个面扣在了床上。

计划里的人已经不见了，还有什么好想的呢。

但她心里对舟舟还有留恋。

虽然她不知道对方在哪个城市，不知道对方长什么样，但她知道舟舟是一个很好的人，他细致，温柔，耐心，只有跟他在一起聊天的时候，自己的心才会从母亲的藩篱中释放出来。

可现在，这一切都成了泡影。

舟舟，你为什么要这样，为什么不能等我几年，还有三年，我就可以毕业了，到时候我就可以去找你，可以跟你光明正大地在一起。

就像你说的我们要一起做饭，一起收拾家务，晚上一起吃完饭，在公园里牵着手散步，回到家一起窝在沙发上看看电影。

她收起手机，重新把头埋进被子里，只留下散落在被子旁边的秀发，还有白皙的腿露在外面。

张晚禾小声地呜咽着，几行清泪顺着脸颊滴在床单上，往日的聊天在脑海回荡。

Page (1/3)

In the bedroom, the curtains cut off the sunlight, and the room became dark. You could vaguely see the pale white decoration style in the room. On the pale white sheets, Zhang Wanning's green silk was like a waterfall, half covering her slender goose neck. There were faint traces of tears on her cold and delicate face. Her slender white legs were crossed, lying on her side on the bed.

Zhang Wanning straightened up suddenly, half-leaned on the bedside table, smoothed his hair with his hands, and took out his mobile phone from under the pillow.

Countless late nights and dense call records.

Looking at the last message he sent, she stopped her fingers and sighed. The boy who had been with her for more than a year just left her.

She wanted to add him back and tell him: "We can meet, I can go to you now!".But is it really possible?

She turned over and lay flat on the bed, and her phone rang.

My mother sent a message saying, "Don't forget your afternoon piano lesson. Teacher Li said you are not in good condition."】

Piano, flower arranging, dance, etiquette classes, etc., my mother has made me learn so much since I was a child, just to train myself to be a lady, so that I can marry a rich second generation in the future, a family that can bring help to my mother's small company.

"Wan He, my mother is strict with you for your own good. A girl should look like a girl so that she will not be looked down upon by others when she goes to a good family. This way, people will think that you are a girl who cares for her husband and raises her children. Then I can also enjoy happiness with you."

This is also the reason why his mother has not allowed herself to have contact with the opposite sex since she was a child. Perhaps it is so that she can sell it at a good price to boys, but she really wants to ask her mother, "Am I just a commodity in your eyes?"

But now she doesn't have the confidence, because she also needs the material conditions provided by her mother to maintain her studies. Similarly, her current plan is to study and have her own job after graduation so that she can get rid of all this.

According to her original plan, after graduating from college, she would find a good job, tell her sister clearly that she liked Zhouzhou, and let her sister understand that she really liked Zhouzhou. She believed that her sister could understand her.

After all, she knew that her sister had liked to grab things from her since she was a child, and agreeing to her at that time was also the result of her hard work.After graduation, she plans to work in the city where Zhouzhou is located, rent a house, raise a kitten, and work and live together with Zhouzhou.

Thinking of this, she turned her phone over and clasped it on the bed.

The people in the plan are gone, so what else is there to think about.

But she still has nostalgia for Zhouzhou in her heart.

Although she didn't know which city the other party was in or what he looked like, she knew that Zhouzhou was a very good person. He was meticulous, gentle and patient. Only when chatting with him could her heart be released from her mother's barriers.

But now, all this is in vain.

Zhouzhou, why are you like this? Why can't you wait for me for a few years? In three years, I will graduate. Then I can go to you and be with you openly.

Just like you said, we will cook together, clean up the housework together, have dinner together in the evening, hold hands and walk in the park, and when we get home, we will curl up on the sofa and watch a movie together.

She put away her phone and buried her head in the quilt again, leaving only her hair scattered beside the quilt and her white legs exposed.

Zhang Wanhe sobbed softly, a few lines of clear tears dripping down his cheeks on the sheets, and the past chats echoed in his mind.
